# mv: rewriteUses handles assignment LHS (non-DEFINE assign path)
mv x s.x
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{}

var s T
var x int

func f() {
	x = 1
	_ = x
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,11 +1,12 @@
 package m

-type T struct{}
+type T struct {
+	x int
+}

 var s T
-var x int

 func f() {
-	x = 1
-	_ = x
+	s.x = 1
+	_ = s.x
 }
